verdict.rationale: Twilio documents unattended call handling: it can respond to incoming calls, gather input, record and take payments without a person answering (twilio-docs-23). Community users describe running hosted TwiML bins and Twilio Functions, small background automations, and voicemail-to-webhook with transcription (twilio-comm-11, twilio-comm-15, twilio-comm-17). These are event-triggered communication behaviors rather than a general autonomous automation or agent feature, and one user notes the hosted options cannot even forward an SMS to email (twilio-comm-11). missing for 10: documented workflow/automation builder, scheduled or recurring background jobs, autonomous agent execution, first-party docs on hosted serverless automation.
